comment: Curated wire idiosyncrasies, injected by generate.py --coverage as a
dedicated Quirks tab (separate from the systematic item.h sweep).
Each entry: id; status (verified-in-data = seen in real wire data we
inspected ourselves - a userstore survey or archived public-stash
captures; documented = developer docs / changelog / confirmed by GGG;
reported = firsthand account or issue tracker; community = third-party
tool workaround or relayed capture we did not re-inspect); source;
description; and either an 'item' object (merged into a generated
rare's JSON - unknown keys are deliberate, they exercise tolerant
parsing; null deletes a key, the string "__null__" emits a literal
JSON null), or 'tab'/'tabs' objects (each emitted as
its own empty stash tab, so metadata quirks do not overwrite each
other). The 2016 wire corpus is the 4,658-item public-stash feed
embedded in the 2016-10-15 web.archive.org snapshot of GGG's
developer docs, mined and re-verified locally on Aug 8 2026.

quirks.source: GGG confirmed leading zeros (src/util/util.cpp GetTabColor); divicards fixtures; gerwaric report, Discord Aug 8 2026
quirks.description: Stash tab colour hex strings arrive with leading zeros stripped: 'ff' means 0000ff, 'bf00' means 00bf00.

quirks.source: gerwaric/acquisition#43; findings.md F51 (~30 unnamed tabs on a real account)
quirks.description: Tab names can be the empty string; name is unusable as a key, only id is.

quirks.source: real 1135-tab dump via research agent: ~900 names end ' (Remove-only)' (server-side rename at league end); duplicate names incl. Latin '1c' vs Cyrillic '1с'
quirks.description: GGG mutates tab names server-side; duplicates and homoglyph collisions are normal.

quirks.source: 3.10-era Standard userstore survey, Aug 8 2026 (50 of 43k items)
quirks.description: Items cached before the field existed carry frameType but no frameTypeId.

quirks.source: itemmod.h reader comment; confirmed with GGG web developer pre-3.29 (PHP json_encode of an empty associative array)
quirks.description: GGG's serializer encodes a mod with no flags as "flags": [] instead of an object.

quirks.source: 3.10-era Standard userstore survey, Aug 8 2026 (1650 gems); 2016 wire corpus
quirks.description: Socketed gems carry legacy socket (index) and colour (S/D/I/G attribute, not R/G/B/W) fields, and no x/y/inventoryId.

quirks.source: 2016 wire corpus: 337 gems with "support": false; docs annotate support 'always true if present'
quirks.description: support is documented always-true-if-present but the wire sends explicit false on active gems.

quirks.source: 2016 wire corpus: corrupted:false on 4136 and lockedToCharacter:false on all 4658 items; modern wire omits false flags
quirks.description: Era-old captures emit optional booleans explicitly false where modern payloads omit them.

quirks.source: 2016 wire corpus: 4468 socket objects, zero sColour (field added ~3.1, Dec 2017)
quirks.description: Pre-3.1 sockets are {group, attr} only; sColour does not exist.

quirks.source: itemsocket.h vocabulary; exile-diary replaces 'DV' with 'D' before counting; attr G = white/generic while sColour G = green
quirks.description: attr can be two characters (DV = resonator) or A (abyssal); the letter G means white in attr but green in sColour.

quirks.source: 2016 wire corpus: 2857 names / 355 typeLines prefixed; removed by GGG in 3.4.3e but persisted data keeps it (item.cpp fixup_name)
quirks.description: name and typeLine carry the <<set:MS>><<set:M>><<set:S>> localisation prefix on pre-3.5 captures.

quirks.source: 3.10-era Standard userstore survey, Aug 8 2026; 2016 corpus flavour lines end in bare \r (2440 of 3668)
quirks.description: Multi-line mod descriptions embed \r\n inside one description string; flavour text lines end in bare \r and split mid-sentence.

flavourText: "Exiled to the sea; what a joke.
I'm more free than I've ever been."

quirks.source: 2016 wire corpus: 14,304/14,304 value pairs are (string, int); 1181 properties with values []; units and ranges baked into the string
quirks.description: Property values are [[string, int]] tuples - always strings even for pure numbers, with +/%/(Max)/n-m/n/m baked in; values can be empty; the int is an undocumented colour code.

quirks.source: poe-custom-elements parseDisplayMode3; out-of-order indices raw-data-verified by research agent; old %0 syntax coexists with {0}
quirks.description: displayMode 3 makes name a format string; %0 and {0} syntaxes both occur and indices can be out of order.

quirks.source: research-agent dump: Int x162 vs Intelligence x9, Dex x152/Dexterity x3, Str x129/Strength x1, plus 'Class:' with trailing colon, in one dataset
quirks.description: Requirement names are inconsistent for the same stat within one payload.

quirks.source: 2016 wire corpus: progress values like 3.49876677319e-06 despite docs claiming 2 decimal places
quirks.description: additionalProperties progress arrives at 12 significant figures, scientific notation included, and int 1 vs float for the same field.

quirks.source: 2016 wire corpus: talismanTier 1-4 on 328 items; documented until removed in 3.29.0; never modeled in item.h
quirks.description: Old items carry keys the app has never modeled; the tolerant reader must skip them and the raw cache must preserve them.

quirks.source: docs list frameType 8 as the legacy Prophecy tombstone; no real prophecyText payload evidenced in any corpus we hold - docs say ?string, item.h models array of string, so the true wire shape is UNRESOLVED and this entry follows the app model. prophecyDiffText pairs with it (PoE wiki 2017, Procurement fixtures) but is absent from current docs and item.h
quirks.description: Prophecy items (2.3-3.17) survive on Standard with prophecyText and frameType 8, predating frameTypeId.

quirks.source: standalone elder/shaper booleans shipped 3.0-3.8 before the influences object (3.9); both still ship; item.cpp LoadInfluences merges five sources
quirks.description: Pre-3.9 items carry top-level elder/shaper true with no influences object; searing/tangled never joined influences.

quirks.source: xyzz/acquisition#11 (Vaal gems invisible until hybrid.baseTypeName rule); exile-diary tests typeLine 'Vaal' prefix instead
quirks.description: Vaal gems nest the real base name and a second property list under hybrid; typeLine alone misleads.

quirks.source: GGG forum thread 2936225: present on 5-digit stacks, rounded textual form
quirks.description: stackSizeText appears only above 9999 and is a lossy abbreviation of stackSize.

quirks.source: research-agent dumps: stackSize 209 / maxStackSize 5000 / property '209/20' (20 = per-slot display cap); div card 36/3
quirks.description: stackSize, maxStackSize, and the Stack Size property text are three mutually inconsistent numbers.

quirks.source: 2016 wire corpus: 100% http:// icons with ?scale/w/h/v params; modern forms are https gen/image base64 or relative paths
quirks.description: Old captures use http:// icon URLs; URL form drifted twice since and query params carry semantics (mb=1 = blighted, relic=1).

quirks.source: 2016 wire corpus: 195 items with bare artFilename (no path, no extension)
quirks.description: Divination cards carry artFilename as a bare filename.

quirks.source: archived doc feeds 2017-2019: category polymorphic (bare string then object of arrays, arrays may be empty); removed 3.26.0; unmodeled in item.h
quirks.description: The removed top-level category key survives in old captures as an object of arrays (and once shipped as a bare string).

quirks.source: exilence-next guards properties/sockets against null despite non-optional types; one real abyss jewel carried colour: null; /trade/fetch returns null array elements
quirks.description: Fields documented as optional arrays can arrive as JSON null rather than absent.

quirks.source: item.h comment says string, wire sends int (17k items in userstore survey)
quirks.description: Field types drift between docs and wire; monsterLevel is documented as string but arrives as an int.

quirks.source: 3.10-era Standard userstore survey, Aug 8 2026 (67 items, Standard only); crucible.nodes is an object keyed by stringified ints, not an array
quirks.description: Crucible (3.21) mod trees exist only on items parked in Standard; every retired league mechanic migrates there permanently.
